title: 王孝忠侨批
description: 这张1952年的侨批封面以“王孝忠先生收”标明收件人，地址指向澄海莲阳一带，左侧记有“外付港币参拾元”。姓名、地址与款项同列于一纸，体现了侨批既传递私人书信，也承担跨境汇款记录的双重功能。部分地址及经手人字迹仍待考证。
descriptionEn: Dated 1952, this qiaopi envelope is addressed to Wang Xiaozhong in the Lianyang area of Chenghai. It records a remittance of 30 Hong Kong dollars. The names, address and payment details reveal how qiaopi served as both personal correspondence and a means of transferring money between overseas Chinese communities and their hometowns.
